text:
lina_support: heads-up — enterprise customer (acct 82-PLG) reporting intermittent parse failures from structured-output mode. They see occasional leading garbage bytes and then valid JSON, so our parser chokes. sample payload attached by customer below.

sam_support: can you paste the raw response sample? also which model + SDK call parameters?

lina_support: pasted raw: ```
\u0000\u0000}random
\u0001\u0002{"user":{"id":123,"name":"J"},"intent":"purchase"}
```

maria_sre: thanks. looks like a leading non-printable prefix before the JSON object. not typical but we saw this once when model tokenization or response framing produced stray bytes. first triage: reproduce with same model/version + prompt in a loop.

alex_prodeng: repro commands (local):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-v2.1","mode":"json","prompt":"<their prompt>"}' \
  | hexdump -C | head -n 20
```
This will show any non-ASCII prefix.

sam_support: immediate mitigation we recommend to CS: 1) quick sanitize on our edge: strip bytes before first "{" or "[" 2) re-ask prompt once with explicit system instruction: "ONLY_RETURN_VALID_JSON_WITHOUT_PREFIX_OR_EXPLANATION" 3) exponential backoff retry up to 3 attempts with jitter.

maria_sre: suggested regex to strip prefix (bash):
```bash
sed -e 's/^[^{\[]*//' <<< "$RAW_RESPONSE"
```
That removes everything until the first { or [ . Works for ASCII; for NUL bytes use: `tr -d '\\000'` first.

ops_oncall: note — sanitizing is a bandaid; we should avoid silently masking signals. add logging metric for sanitized_responses and payload_sample to S3 for audit when sanitize triggers. file retention 7 days.

dev-bot: incident template created: INCIDENT-2026-045-json-sanitize for tracking.

alex_prodeng: for a robust repair flow: 1) parse attempt 2) if parse fail -> attempt deterministic cleanup (tr/truncate regex) 3) parse attempt 2 -> if still fails -> re-ask model with a short cleanup prompt + include original model output as context and "fix_json_only": true 4) exponential backoff 2nd re-ask -> if still fails escalate to human with raw payload.

lina_support: can you share the re-ask prompt we want CS to use?

sam_support: re-ask example: ```
System: You are an assistant that only outputs valid JSON and never any surrounding text.
User: The assistant produced an output that may have extra characters. Clean it and return the corrected JSON only.
Context: <<<PASTE_RAW_OUTPUT_HERE>>>
```
Keep it short. avoid extra commentary.

maria_sre: add small timeout gap between retries: 200ms * 2^attempt + random(0..150)ms. implement up to 3 attempts. record latencies and token deltas.

ops_oncall: customer billing note — if we auto-retry we might double bill tokens. for hosted plan, credit customer for retries caused by our parser issues. mark as support credit case.

lina_support: CS will offer credit and enable a feature flag on their account to turn on server-side sanitize for 48hrs while we root-cause.

alex_prodeng: long term: add a JSON-mode strictness header at protocol level so clients can opt into strict or tolerant parsing. we'll spec as `X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict|tolerant|repair` and wire into runtime.

sam_support: noted. for now I'll roll a short playbook for support docs and PR to SDK: include auto-sanitize option with explicit consent + opt-out.

maria_sre: any idea root cause? possible sources: model decoding bug, framing issue in streaming pipeline, or upstream proxy binary prefix. prioritize capturing raw bytes.

lina_support: customer is on dedicated capacity but said issue started after a model upgrade last week. filing for Dedicated infra to correlate deploy timestamps.

ops_oncall: tagging infra team. @ops_oncall please collect node logs for the customer's pool between 2026-02-09T02:00 and 2026-02-11T06:00.

ops_oncall: on it — will attach logs to INCIDENT-2026-045.

sam_support: follow-up checklist for CS: 1) reproduce locally using curl/hexdump 2) if leading bytes present, enable sanitize flag 3) run re-ask once (with backoff) 4) if still broken escalate to infra and offer credit 5) collect sanitized sample and mark telemetry.

lina_support: CS notified customer and applied temporary sanitize flag. they reported immediate improvement (:white_check_mark:). will keep incident open until infra root cause done.

alex_prodeng: PR idea: SDKs should include built-in sanitizer utility: `Redwood.sanitizeJSON(raw)` with the sed/tr tr fallback and a log hook. I'll draft.

maria_sre: also add a unit test harness that fuzzes outputs with random prefixes to ensure sanitizer doesn't corrupt legit leading text (rare for arrays).

lina_support: thanks team — filing postmortem template once root cause confirmed. closing this thread for day-to-day ops, keeping incident ticket open. :thumbsup:

sam_support: tagging for knowledge base: /kb/structured-output/parse-failure-repair-playbook will be updated.
